title: Donald Knuth - My advice to young people (93/97)
channel: Web of Stories - Life Stories of Remarkable People
summary: A five-minute clip from Donald Knuth's Web of Stories interviews in which he gives advice to young people, including being wary when too many people adopt an idea.
why: HN quotes it as a source for Knuth's caution against believing something is good just because it is trendy.

quote.text: Donald Knuth interviews are so interesting
